summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, furnishing a press release covering Q1 2026 results. The release highlights a first binding customer offtake agreement with Trafigura covering >40% of targeted offtake for the SWA Project, operational milestones at the demonstration plant (1M barrels brine processed, 15,000 DLE cycles, zero incidents over 6 years), and progress toward a Final Investment Decision and construction start in 2026. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine quarterly update on commercial and operational developments, not a special situation.
